advices.diagnosis: The ReportView class has a low cohesion score (LCOM4=2) and references two internal classes (DCC=2), indicating that it mixes presentation logic with data access and mail delivery responsibilities. The class also exhibits a feature‑envy candidate smell in describe_customer, but the primary design issue is the coupling between presentation and application layers.

suggestions.title: Extract mail delivery into a dedicated service
suggestions.sketch: Create a new class in the application layer, e.g. `ReportMailer`, that takes an `EmailClient` and an `OrderRepository` in its constructor and exposes a method `send_summary(address: str)`. Move the current `mail_summary` implementation into this class. In `ReportView`, remove the `_mailer` attribute and replace calls to `mail_summary` with a call to `ReportMailer.send_summary`. This keeps `ReportView` focused on formatting and presentation only.
notes: addresses_smells names labels the target does not carry: god_class

advices.risk_notes: The refactor introduces a new dependency on the application layer, so any existing code that instantiated `ReportView` with an `EmailClient` must be updated to provide a `ReportMailer` instead. If the mail sending logic is heavily used elsewhere, the new service may become a new point of failure. Additionally, if `ReportView` is used in tests that mock the mailer, the test setup will need to be adjusted.
